name: Aura attach pickers read the whole Enchant line; The Sound of Drums goads only what it enchants
notes: Memory: project_audit_aura_attach_2026-11-11. buildAuraRestriction read only card types and subtypes, so 'Enchant red or green creature' (Controlled Instincts), 'tapped creature' (Entangling Vines), 'creature you don't control' (Captured by the Consulate) and 'artifact creature' (Domineer, read as artifact OR creature) listed too much; the picker now also checks the line as 'target <words>' (buildEnchantTargetRestriction, permanent._auraTargetRestriction). Daybreak Coronet's 'with another Aura attached to it' was a required Aura subtype, so it listed nothing ever (_enchantNeedsOtherAura). 'Enchanted creature is goaded' was a global effect matching every permanent. 'Enchant creature card in a graveyard' (Animate Dead) keeps the type test only: on the battlefield it is on the creature it returned.

scryfallData.name: Animate Dead
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Enchant creature card in a graveyard
When this Aura enters, if it's on the battlefield, it loses "enchant creature card in a graveyard" and gains "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with this Aura." Return enchanted creature card to the battlefield under your control and attach this Aura to it. When this Aura leaves the battlefield, that creature's controller sacrifices it.
Enchanted creature gets -1/-0.
